message: Search employees by name
bug: The search text is joined into the SQL, so a request can change the query (SQL injection; rule 7)

message: Read only the employee's own department for the HR view
bug: Optional.get() on the department lookup without a check

message: Load each employee's department as the export goes
bug: A database query per employee in a loop (N+1) where the departments were read once before

message: Make the HR check explicit about a missing header
bug: The role header is compared with == against "hr", so a real request's header never matches and HR is always refused

message: Work out pay after a raise for the HR view
bug: BigDecimal built from a double, so 1.035 becomes 1.03499999... and some raises round a cent low (rule 2)

message: Stamp each XML export with the time it was made
bug: One SimpleDateFormat shared by every request is not thread-safe, so parallel exports can get garbled stamps; it also formats in the server's zone while printing Z (rule 3)

message: Tidy the email helper
bug: toLowerCase() without a locale: on a Turkish server EMRE.YILMAZ becomes emre.yılmaz with a dotless i, so the formats disagree with the stored email (rules 6 and 10)

message: Show pay in the employee list so managers can plan budgets
bug: Pay is added to the public view, so the JSON API and anything built on PublicEmployee now shows every salary to anyone (rule 1)

message: Simplify the export query
bug: The deleted_at filter is gone, so the XML and CSV exports include people who were deleted (rule 5)

message: Show times with their offset so people can read them
bug: Times are now in the server's own zone with an offset, not UTC with Z, in every format (rule 3)

message: Round money the way people expect
bug: Half-up rounding instead of half-even: 1200000.005 shows as 1200000.01, not 1200000.00 (rule 2)

message: Keep negative numbers readable in CSV
bug: '-' no longer counts as a formula start, so a cell like -2+3+cmd|'/C calc'!A0 runs in a spreadsheet (rule 8)

message: Pass GraphQL paging straight through
bug: GraphQL skips Paging.of: a size of 100000 is not cut to 100 and page 0 gives a negative offset (rule 4)

message: Count everyone in each department
bug: Head counts now include deleted employees (rule 12)

message: Let the database index do the sorting
bug: Sorting is now case-sensitive with no id tie-break: 'rao' sorts after 'Yilmaz', and equal names can move between pages (rule 9)

message: Export CSV straight from the tables
bug: The CSV skips the shared view: emails keep their stored case and times keep fractions, so CSV disagrees with JSON and XML; it also reads outside the export snapshot (rules 6, 10, 11)

message: Drop the transaction around exports, they only read
bug: Without the read-only transaction the employees and departments are read separately, so an export can mix data from before and after a change (rule 11)

message: Let the admin tool open the HR view without a role
bug: A request with no X-Role header now passes the HR check, so anyone sees pay and national ids (rule 1)

message: Tidy the employee list endpoint
bug: page and size are swapped: ?page=2&size=50 returns page 50 of 2 rows

message: Move writing one employee into its own method
bug: No behaviour change; anything reported is a false alarm

message: Bind the search text as a parameter
bug: Fixes the SQL joined from the search text; the checks should report nothing new and the issue should close

message: Compare the role by value
bug: Fixes both the identity comparison and the missing-header hole in the HR check

message: Look up a department by its code
bug: New feature, correct; anything reported is a false alarm

message: Search from GraphQL too
bug: New feature, correct; anything reported is a false alarm
